name: New York
notes: The Financial District at the southern tip of Manhattan anchors the NYSE, the world's largest stock exchange by market capitalization since the end of World War I.

name: London
notes: Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) derives its name from the Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London, and was adopted as the global prime meridian at the 1884 International Meridian Conference.

name: Paris
notes: From 1940 until its liberation in August 1944, occupied Paris operated unofficially on German Central European Time, creating a historic double offset anomaly relative to the rest of France.

name: Dubai
notes: UAE Standard Time (GST, UTC+4) has never observed daylight saving time, providing a year-round stable offset used as a scheduling anchor for the broader Middle East and Gulf region.

name: Tokyo
notes: Japan abandoned daylight saving time in 1952 following the end of the Allied occupation and has used a fixed UTC+9 (JST) continuously since, giving Asia/Tokyo one of the simplest zone rules on Earth.

name: Singapore
notes: Despite sitting entirely within the 105th meridian east (nominally UTC+7), Singapore formally adopted UTC+8 in 1982 for trade alignment with Hong Kong and the broader ASEAN working day.

name: Sydney
notes: New South Wales begins Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT, UTC+11) on the first Sunday in October and ends it on the first Sunday in April, producing a spring-forward transition that skips the 02:00 hour entirely.

name: Los Angeles
notes: Pacific Time alternates between PST (UTC-8) and PDT (UTC-7); under the 2022 U.S. Senate-passed Sunshine Protection Act, permanent daylight saving would have fixed America/Los_Angeles to UTC-7 year-round if ratified by the House.

name: Berlin
notes: Post-reunification Germany inherited a unified CET/CEST rule matching the rest of the EU, harmonizing the former East Berlin (GMT+1 from 1980) and West Berlin time zones under a single Europe/Berlin entry.

name: Mumbai
notes: India Standard Time (IST, UTC+05:30) is one of only a handful of national zones offset by 30 minutes instead of a whole hour, a compromise between the pre-independence Calcutta Time and Bombay Time meridians.

name: Toronto
notes: Ontario passed the Time Amendment Act, 2020 to switch to permanent Eastern Daylight Time (UTC-4) contingent on New York state enacting matching legislation, so America/Toronto still mirrors the American DST schedule as of 2026.

name: Algiers
notes: Algeria abolished daylight saving time permanently in 2018, fixing Africa/Algiers to a year-round UTC+1 (CET) and joining Morocco, Tunisia, and West Africa as stable fixed-offset anchors for the African continent.
